articles.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by 'largest hack in history'
articles.description: The world's biggest crypto exchange said $6.3bn of digital assets had been impacted by the incident.
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that $6.3bn (£4.7bn) of digital assets have been impacted by what has been described as the "largest hack in history".
key_points: The world's biggest crypto exchange said about half of those assets have been frozen with the help of other platforms, adding that it will "cover all losses".
Early checks show the incident may have involved an engineer's laptop that had been compromised, which allowed an attacker to make unauthorised withdrawals, Binance said.

AI-powered investigations company TRM Labs has attributed the incident, which eclipses a record-setting $1.5bn hack on the Bybit exchange in 2025 , to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.

articles.title: From cultivated beef to fermented soy: Bezos-backed protein innovators target cost and scale
articles.description: Aleph Farms and Mottainai Food Tech secure S$1m each to scale cultivated meat and fermented protein, targeting cost, resilience and commercial growth.
articles.summary: Two very different approaches to the future of protein have secured fresh backing in Singapore, with cultivated meat company Aleph Farms and fermentation specialist Mottainai Food Tech named winners of the 2026 Bezos Earth Fund Sustainable Protein Growth Stage Grant.
key_points: The two companies were each awarded S$1m ($780,000) through the initiative.
But their technologies illustrate just how diverse the next generation of alternative protein solutions is becoming.
Israel-based Aleph Farms is developing cultivated beef, growing animal cells rather than raising an entire animal.
